Entropy of a Vector

Source: R/utilities.R
tweedie_entropy.Rd

Compute Shannon entropy for a vector.

Usage

tweedie_entropy(target)

Arguments

target

A vector of values.

Value

A numeric entropy value.

Details

Missing values are excluded from category counts but included in the denominator to preserve the package's metadata-filtering convention. Empty and entirely missing vectors return zero.

References

Shannon CE (1948). A Mathematical Theory of Communication. Bell System Technical Journal, 27, 379-423. doi:10.1002/j.1538-7305.1948.tb01338.x .

Examples

tweedie_entropy(c("A", "A", "B", "B", "C"))
#> [1] 1.521928
